title: Love-Ly Fragrant Jamaican Herbal Mixture En-Croute
description: This dish is a unique blend of flavors and textures, featuring a flaky en-croute crust and a fragrant herbal filling. It's a romantic and diabetic-friendly option for any meal.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
Transfer the pastry to a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
In a bowl, mix together the softened butter, shredded cheddar cheese, olive oil, thyme leaves, cayenne pepper, and minced garlic.
Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the center of the pastry, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Sprinkle the frozen spinach over the cheese mixture.
Fold the 1-inch border of the pastry over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the pastry with a little water and sprinkle with salt.
Bake the pastry in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Remove the pastry from the oven and sprinkle with chopped scallions and parsley leaves if using.
